rules: Use IBM Plex Mono for all data points, numbers, timestamps, and coordinates.
Headlines MUST use tight letter spacing.
Overlines/Labels MUST be Uppercase + Tiny + Wide Spacing.
No pure black or pure white. Tint greys with cool blue/indigo.
Primary color (Yellow/hsl(53, 93%, 50%)) is for critical actions, alerts, or confidence highlights.
Secondary color (Cyan/hsl(184, 100%, 50%)) is for data visualizations and active states.
NO generic full-screen gradients. Use solid colors with subtle 1px borders.
Banned colors: #7351B7 (Purple), #1B93A4 (Teal Green). Use Cyan/Yellow instead.
Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 or 12-column layout for complex panels.
Gap Strategy: Tight (gap-4 or gap-6) inside data panels, wider between main sections.
Use sharp edges or subtle roundness (max 4px border-radius, rounded-sm).
Implement the 'Technical Look': Expose the skeleton. Use border-collapse style layouts where items have border-r border-b border-border/40.
Every pixel utilized, stretch heights using h-full on children.
Avoid empty negative space in data tables; fill with structured empty states.

component_rules.surfaces: Flat Solid surfaces. DO NOT use Glassmorphism for health/scientific data apps as it causes visual refraction. Flat dark backgrounds with 1px hard borders.
shadcn: Use Shadcn components for complex logic: Select, Dialog, Form, Tabs.
DO NOT overuse generic Cards. Build cardless, rectangular, dense data panels.
Use Recharts or Shadcn Charts for data viz. Style them with Cyan and Warning Yellow.
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds on dropdowns or overlays.
component_rules.map_picker: Integrate an interactive map (react-map-gl/Mapbox, leaflet, or similar) heavily styled in dark mode with neon accents for data points.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grid lines or crosshairs at corners of major data panels. Scanlines for a terminal feel.
visual_enhancers.data_presentation: Prediction cards MUST show confidence scores with explicit visual indicators (e.g., Progress bars or radial charts). Ensure Timestamp and Source citations are prominent.

rules: Minimalist animations. Micro-interactions for feedback.
Hover states MUST explicitly change background and text color.
Do NOT use transition: all. Use specific transitions (e.g., transition: background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease).
data-testid MUST be added to all interactive elements (kebab-case, role-based).
Maintain minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for text.
Focus states MUST have higher contrast than default state.

images.description: Earth at night view. Use this if the interactive map is loading or as a hero background for the login/signup page.
Abstract topography map. Can be heavily darkened and used as a subtle background pattern for 'Saved Locations' or 'Evidence' sidebars.

icons.style: Use 'regular' or 'bold' weight for clarity in dense data environments.

3d_libraries.purpose: For immersive, dark-mode city maps. Avoid default Google Maps styling. Essential for the Location search + map picker requirement.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install the required fonts: Chivo and IBM Plex Mono via Google Fonts in index.html.
Update tailwind.config.js and index.css with the provided precise HSL colors and ensure Dark Mode is default.
Implement the 'Earth Intelligence report card' as a dense, grid-based dashboard with terminal-like data panels.
Ensure 'Prediction cards' highlight Confidence scores and data timestamps prominently using the Mono font.
No centered layouts for data. Left-align text for readability.
Follow the 'Technical Look' surface strategy: exposed grids, 1px borders, solid flat dark backgrounds.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters ONLY where appropriate (avoid for scientific data panels).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use 'sonner' for toasts. Located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js or .jsx.
GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: Direct Children Only: Grid items MUST be direct children of grid containers.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background.
